description_en: Saves user-configured storage information such as the storage duration and storage region
description_zh: 保存用户设置的存储天数，存储地域（region）等信息
name: SetStorage

parameters.help_en: The log storage duration in days. Default value: 180. Minimum value: 30. Maximum value: 3000
parameters.help_zh: 日志存储天数，默认180天。该值最小设置为30天，最大不能超过3000天
parameters.name: ttl

parameters.help_en:
The log storage region.

If the data management center is located in cn-hangzhou, the default value of Region is Shanghai (cn-shanghai). If the data management center is located in ap-southeast-1, the default value of Region is Singapore (ap-southeast-1).

You cannot change the log storage region. To change the log storage region, contact the operations personnel of Threat Analysis
parameters.help_zh:
日志存储地域。

数据管理中心所在地为cn-hangzhou时，Region默认为上海（cn-shanghai）；数据管理中心所在地为ap-southeast-1时，Region默认为新加坡（ap-southeast-1）。

不可以修改日志存储地域。如需修改，请联系威胁分析的运营人员
parameters.name: region

parameters.help_en:
The view type. Valid values:

0: the view of the current Alibaba Cloud account.
1: the view of all accounts in the enterprise
parameters.help_zh:
视图类型。

0：当前阿里云账号视图。
1：企业下所有账号的视图
parameters.name: role_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the user whose perspective the administrator switches to
parameters.help_zh: 管理员切换成其他成员视角的用户ID
parameters.name: role_for

parameters.help_en:
The region of the data management center for Threat Analysis. Select the region of the management center based on the region where your assets are located. Valid values:
cn-hangzhou: Select this value if your assets are located in the Chinese mainland and Hong Kong (China).
ap-southeast-1: Select this value if your assets are located outside China
parameters.help_zh:
威胁分析的数据管理中心所在地。您需要根据资产所在地域，选择管理中心所在地。取值：
cn-hangzhou：资产属于中国内地与中国香港，选择该项。
ap-southeast-1：资产属于海外地域，选择该项
parameters.name: region_id

Data.description_en:
Indicates whether the settings are saved. Valid values:
true: The settings are saved.
false: The settings fail to be saved
Data.description_zh:
是否保存成功。取值：
true：成功
false：失败
